pages.text: The 5 tags introduced in this section mainly affect a neko's $(#FF69B4)social behavior$() — how she treats her owner, strangers, and other nekos. These tags are the easiest to notice in daily interactions~

pages.title: mesugaki · Bratty
pages.text: $(#FF69B4)"Hmph! No way I'm gonna listen to you~ Want to tame me? Show me what you've got!"$()$(br2)Bratty nekos are naturally rebellious. A normal $(item)Contract$() simply $(#FF69B4)won't work$() on her — you must enchant the contract with $(thing)Enforcement$() to tame her.$(br2)She'll still talk back after being tamed, but that's just her way of expressing herself. The secret to handling a bratty neko? Outplay her at her own game!

pages.title: gentleness · Gentle
pages.text: $(#FF69B4)"You're hurt? Let me help..."$()$(br2)Gentle nekos are undisputed $(#FF69B4)angels$(). She actively seeks out injured creatures within a 5-block radius and feeds them food from her inventory to heal them.$(br2)If you get injured, she'll be the first to run over and care for you. Having a gentle neko is like carrying a little nurse everywhere~

pages.title: haraguro · Two-faced
pages.text: $(#FF69B4)"Hehe~ I don't mean anything by it~"$()$(br2)Two-faced nekos appear $(#FF69B4)gentle and harmless$() on the surface, always smiling — but deep down, they have their own schemes.$(br2)It's hard to tell anything unusual from her outward behavior... which is exactly what makes the two-faced nature so terrifying (or charming). Her actions often carry hidden intentions — it never hurts to stay alert...

pages.title: narenareshi · Sociable
pages.text: $(#FF69B4)"Hey! Long time no see!"$()$(br2)Sociable nekos are extreme extroverts. She will $(#FF69B4)actively approach non-owner players$(), and when she spots a stranger within 8 blocks, she'll run over and hang around them for $(#FF69B4)2~4 seconds$().$(br2)As if saying "Hi there! Let's be friends!" — her social skills are maxed out, requiring zero effort from her owner.

pages.title: yuri · Yuri
pages.text: $(#FF69B4)"Owner~ come a little closer~"$()$(br2)Yuri nekos have a special affinity for neko owners. $(#FF69B4)If her owner is also a neko$(), her follow distance will be $(#FF69B4)noticeably shorter$() — not because she's afraid of falling behind, but because she wants to stay as close as possible.$(br2)The bond between two nekos is more intimate than that of an ordinary neko and owner. If you're also a neko, the yuri tag lets you experience double the closeness!
